stdout:
Reviewed HHH-21070 at commit 64eccc82e18bb245962bf972d341a686d83462d7. No actionable findings; no review changes were needed.

The one-line change uses Enum.getDeclaringClass() only in the unknown JDBC parameter fallback, so EnumJavaType receives the actual enum declaration rather than a constant-specific anonymous subclass. Existing explicit/contextual mappings, registered types, SQL-type indicators and null behavior retain their precedence.

The regression tests keep unknown class-body and ordinary enums separate from the mapped STRING enum control. Native assertions check ordinal 1, HQL assertions exercise a parameter without mapped inference, and mapped/null controls preserve known-type behavior.

Verified evidence:
- Native baseline RED: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/42103175038. One intended NPE failure, no errors/skips.
- Native tracer-bullet GREEN: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/42103928296. One test passed plus formatChecks.
- HQL baseline RED: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/42105360337. One intended matching NPE failure, no errors/skips.
- Candidate GREEN: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/42106038838. All 18 tests passed.
- Exact work PR head recheck: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/42107277500. Fresh execution of all 18 tests across five classes passed with zero failures/errors/skips. Compilation and repository formatChecks passed on JDK 25/H2. Artifact 13453162256 records base 64eccc82e18bb245962bf972d341a686d83462d7, identical source/tested tree a52e3639e739ccfe9e96c049f5f1944cb9511eff and an empty post-formatter patch. The current-head gate also passed.

A separate static review and artifact inspection found no additional issues and confirmed the intended failures, complete counts and exact test source. No local Java execution was used.

Coverage limits: focused tests only, not the full Hibernate suite or cross-dialect matrix. Native regressions intentionally target H2. Supplied-type precedence is preserved by unchanged control flow rather than a dedicated new explicit-type test. These limits do not justify broadening this internal one-line fix. Full upstream CI remains applicable to an eventual upstream submission. No unresolved human review threads were present. No official PR publication, merge or release was performed.
